shared_elements: human figures holding or raising an elongated object (staff/weapon)
boats or boat-like sign (barque under winged disc in A; ships with crew strokes in B)
rows of repeated small signs along a horizontal line
justification: Both show schematic human figures in frontal stance with arms engaging an elongated object, plus repeated small signs strung along a line and, arguably, boat imagery — but these are generic and appear in totally different forms. A is a tightly ruled, register-based composition dominated by dense rows of small pictographic signs beneath a lunette of seated/standing figures flanking discs, while B is an open, unruled field of large silhouetted figures, ships with crew strokes, and scattered marks with no register structure or writing.}
